# eTrue Mart

> eTrue Mart is a B2B wholesale sourcing platform based in Yiwu, China. It connects international buyers with Yiwu factories for fashion jewelry, accessories, bags, apparel, home decor, kitchen supplies, electronics, toys and more. Factory-direct pricing, low MOQ (minimum 12 pcs), global shipping to 180+ countries.

## Business rules

- Minimum order: $100 USD (wholesale only, no retail)
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): starts from 12 pcs per product
- No free shipping — shipping is calculated at checkout based on destination, weight and volumetric weight
- Payment methods: T/T (bank transfer), PayPal, L/C, Western Union
- Processing time: 3-5 business days before shipment
- OEM/ODM services available: custom packaging, private label, logo printing

## Company

- Company: YIWU ETRUE TRADING CO.,LTD (义乌弋楚贸易有限公司)
- Location: Yiwu, Zhejiang, China (geo: 29.3056, 120.0762)
